ops.body:
cc-pool store DIAGNOSIS VERDICT (source-proven, fingerprints reproduced): pool-v1.db on yasyf-home is a VALID store from the v0.60.0–v0.61.7 schema epoch (fingerprint 01af1e6d, introduced c2147e4 Jul 20) — not corrupt, not half-migrated. The swarm shipped THREE incompatible schema epochs in 4 days (01af1e6d → fbde893a @ v0.62-0.63.3 → 0efa0acc @ v0.64.x), each verified with exact DDL-hash equality on EVERY store open (store.go:583-604, via withManager), with zero migration code anywhere (04ce289 removed it all) and zero records of the cutovers. Every post-0.61.7 binary fails closed — which is exactly why both machines' daemons died at their upgrade moments.

Implications for repair:
- **Credentials are SAFE**: the DB holds Keychain locators + digests only; secrets are in the macOS Keychain.
- **Nothing can accidentally destroy the store**: init/doctor/service/sync all refuse before running. No urgency hazard.
- **Recovery is USER-GATED**: `ccp add` mints a new instance_id → new config dir → new derived Keychain service, so old Keychain items are unreachable and every account needs a fresh interactive `claude auth login`. Recipe: read-only sqlite3 roster dump (labels + locators) → archive pool-v1.db aside → let 0.64.8 create fresh → re-add + re-login per account, restoring labels. pool.db (9.5MB) is pre-Jul-20 legacy nothing reads; archive.
- **The box is likely the same epoch**: its install was `HEAD-06621a7 0.61.7` — expect the identical mismatch after its upgrade to 0.64.8; same disposition (read-only roster dump, park, no recreate).
- Bug being filed in cc-pool's own cc-notes backlog (no-migration/fail-closed/no-tooling) by the diagnosis lane.

Home lane instructed to take the read-only roster dump (account count, labels, acct-11/acct-18 presence, config_dir existence) and hold everything else. cc-pool leg on BOTH machines now waits on the user for interactive re-auth.
